decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound draws directly on the firm's woodworking, turning and assembly skills, so management can read customer response and refine the models within its existing knowledge base.
The one-tier arched pyramid is a core Erzgebirge-style piece fully within the firm's craft competence and fits the steady demand for traditional seasonal décor.

With the electronic music box line and the Christmas platform already withdrawn, this accessory lacks both a complementary product and the electronics know-how needed to interpret and improve it, so its resources are better returned to core craftsmanship.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid craftsmanship and regional design knowledge, making its results easy to interpret and build on.
